description: DAO-COLL: two writable Databases on one file in Workspaces(0). A table M1 is created by SQL in db. Captured: Count of a TableDefs collection held from before the change, of a fresh one, and of db2's before and after Refresh; Delete('M1') twice and Count after each. Saved-query creation against the Tables container's Documents Count before and after Refresh. Appending relation RelTC (T.ID to C.CID) against C's held Indexes Count and its Index names before and after Refresh. Errors.
retentionNote: Designed r-dao-1-err-1 probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
